<!-- pr-reviewer: 3152dec37fc427e9c3b9ed26c67beddbce5fa748 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This PR repairs the two stale app tests that made main red (issue #1924). The review is light and test-only.

**What looks good**

- The diff touches only the two test files and the decision file. No `src/` file changed. The reach law from #1895 stays intact.
- `docs_troubleshooting.rs`: the path now names `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md`. The file exists at this head, and the old page path is gone. The count guard (`found.len() > 20`) and the stale-stem assert stay. The test still checks every quoted message stem against the sources.
- `operations.rs`: only the box stock height changed (20 mm to 5 mm). The batch path, the serial loop, and the bit-for-bit cache and stamp compares stay. No `#[ignore]` was added and no assert was removed. The test still proves batch/serial parity.
- `docs/decisions/1924-red-main-app-tests.md` records the choice, the reason, and the dropped options in the agreed format.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #1924`. The commit subject follows Conventional Commits.

**Results (run locally, in the review worktree, head 3152dec)**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test docs_troubleshooting` | ok — 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test operations` | ok — 120 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `threaded_batch_matches_the_serial_loop_bit_for_bit --exact` | ok — 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Merge check | merges cleanly with main (d1484f02a) |

**Requested before merge**

- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The body names post-merge run 43723593734. That run failed on the earlier tip 6f8b309dc. The run on the current tip d1484f02a was 43728488705. Both failed on the same two tests, so the repair is right either way.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
